2334.closed: Contemporary decipherment on record: Staffetti, Il cardinale Innocenzo Cybo (1894) p. 195 n. 2 cites "Il Cardinale al Duca, 24 di maggio, deciferato. Archivio Mediceo, filza 3716" and paraphrases and quotes it (Covos and Granvela, the audience with Charles V on Vitelli and Filippo Strozzi). This 335 copy is marked "Dup.", was begun 23 and finished 25 May 1538 at Nice, and its clear passages match (Covos and Granvela, the mandate from Cosimo). The identity rests on date, the duplicate mark and content; the 3716 decipherment was not seen.
